sentences.text: 3. Vide order dated 19.05.2010, the matter was referred to the mediation before the Mediation Centre of this Court.

As per the reported dated 25.11.2010, received from the Mediation Centre of this Court, the parties have settled their disputes amicably and applicant and opposite party no.2 have decided to re-unite themselves as husband and wife and the parties have agreed to withdraw all the civil and criminal cases against each other.

In view of the settlement dated 25.11.2010, as arrived at Mediation Centre of this Court, which reads as under:

"ALLAHABAD HIGH COURT MEDIATION AND CONCILIATION CENTRE SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT entered into on 25.11.2010 between Sri Manoj (applicant-husband) and Smt.Aneeta alias Pinki (O.P.
no.2-Wife).
WHEREAS 1

entities.text: ALLAHABAD HIGH COURT MEDIATION AND CONCILIATION CENTRE SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Disputes and differences had arisen between the Parties hereto and Crl.
Misc Application No. 13396 of 2010 was filed before the Hon'ble High Court.
2. The matter was referred to mediation/conciliation vide order dated 19.5.2010 passed by Hon'ble Mr. Justice Vinod Prasad.
3. The parties agreed that Mr.Abrar Ahmad and Mr.J.P.Gupta, Advocates would act as their Conciliator/Mediator, in the Mediation Case N0.3746 of 2010.

4. Several joint and separate meetings were held during the process of Conciliation/Mediation on 25.11.2010 and the parties have with the assistance of the Mediator/Conciliator voluntarily arrived at an amicable solution resolving the above-mentioned disputes and differences.
5. The parties hereto confirm and declare that they have voluntarily and of their own free will arrived at this Settlement Agreement in the presence of the Mediator/Conciliator.

6. The following settlement has been arrived at between the Parties hereto:-
a.

That Sri Manoj (applicant-husband) and Smt. Aneeta alias Pinki (O.P. no.2-Wife)
were married on 11.11.2008.
Due to strained relations between them, they were living separately.

b. That now both the parties have decided to reunite and live together as husband and wife in perfect harmony and fulfill all their matrimonial obligations towards each other without committing any kind of cruelty.

c. That in view of above noted agreement between the parties, both the parties agree that all civil and criminal cases filed by them against each other including the above noted ones, shall be treated to be withdrawn for all practical purposes from today itself.
They agree that they will file proper application before the appropriate court for withdrawing the aforesaid cases.
7. By signing this Agreement the Parties hereto state that they have no further claims or demands against each other with respect to Crl. Mise.
Application No. 13396 of 2010 and all matrimonial disputes and differences in this regard
have been amicably settled by the Parties hereto through the process of Conciliation/Mediation.

are hereby quashed.
